rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for the idea of never dying or living forever.

example.english: People say this elixir can grant immortality.
example.traditional: 呢粒仙丹真係可以令人長生不死。
example.jyutping: ne1 nap1 sin1 daan1 zan1 hai6 ho2 ji5 ling6 jan4 coeng4 saang1 bat1 sei2

rows.note: Use this mainly for eternal life in a religious or spiritual context, not ordinary claims about avoiding death.

example.english: Believers think sincere prayer can bring immortality.
example.traditional: 信徒相信虔誠祈禱可以得到永生。
example.jyutping: seon3 tou4 soeng1 seon3 kin4 sing4 kei4 tou2 ho2 ji5 dak1 dou3 wing5 sang1

rows.note: Use this when someone is remembered forever through their place in history, rather than literally living forever.

example.english: Their great contribution to society will give them immortality in the history books.
example.traditional: 佢對社會貢獻咁大，梗係可以名留青史。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 se5 wui2 gung3 hin3 gam3 daai6 gang2 hai6 ho2 ji5 ming4 lau4 cing1 si2
